contexts.text: Abram was a son of ninety years and nine years () = the time before the Lord fully conjoined the internal man with the rational; as is evident from the signification of nine as coming before ten...
Nine = conjunction, or that which is conjoined.
They go to the ninth use. Explained.
By the third, sixth, and ninth hour () is signified a like state of life... Three = a full state, or what is complete even to the end. The like [is signified by] six, and nine.

Darkness upon the whole earth, even to the ninth hour ()... From the sixth hour to the ninth = that there was mere falsity, and not any truth whatever; for... six, and nine = all things in the complex; here, falsities and evils.
